<issue_description>
Heap-buffer-overflow in BMP parsing: bmp_read_image (load-bmp.c) can read past the end of the allocated image/palette buffer when handling crafted BMP files, causing a heap out-of-bounds read. This can lead to crashes, potential information disclosure, or other memory-corruption impacts when decoding BMP images (seen via fz_load_bmp_subimage / img_load_page).
